entry_points.text: Typesafe setup builds a guarded cache and squared-payload array with selected acquire and release pairs; readers affinitize, wait, time one iteration, sync phases, and signal completion.
Torture workers do boot and affinity setup, loop until shutdown with stutter checks, and announce stopping on return.

exports.text: Deferred unlock restores interrupts and forwards normal and expedited needs via hierarchy reporting, with progress diagnostics, no-callback confinement, and priority query.

hazards.text: Warnings flag wrong nodes, completion with readers or bits left, stale reports, wrong-CPU use, duplicate stalls, torn versions and unbalanced protections; coordination uses named defer, scan, tick and notifier symbols.
Duplicate checking pins a period and queues same objects then barriers; single-element deadlock cycles may hang; failed init cleans up and may power off when shutdown is configured.

invariants.text: Blocked readers stay on first leaf with separate normal, expedited and boost heads; removal clears linkage and advances heads, and non-preemptible builds report none.
Normal reports clear urgent and heavy flags and release tick dependency on tickless CPUs; backlog reads return zero when disabled else queued count.
Start-stall warnings need debug build, idle period, outstanding work and aged timestamps; boost needs explicit mode and priority; hotplug id persists; NMI and sync are conditional.
Forward progress bounds threads by CPUs, needs callback and barrier support with mutex publication; barrier skips without callbacks; teardown stops workers in order and reports outcome.
Preemption cycles online CPUs with retries; lockdep helper wraps only in deadlock mode; init matches ops by name, clamps counts, and suppresses toggles for stall-only runs.
Refscale loops inclusive counts with optional pauses, describes flavors by init and plain and delay hooks, shares sleepable control, and omits tasks and trace when unsupported.
Flavors bind init, plain and delay routines; ref, spin and sequence share boolean acquire and release; warm and cool loops run to deadline and aggregate durations with separate phase counters.
External helpers for atomics, per-CPU, barriers, irq, preemption, locking, waits, time, allocation, warnings and lists live in owning dossiers.

locks.text: Each level serializes on its node lock with interrupts disabled, releases exactly once per exit, hands child to parent in order, and releases root before waking the grace thread.
Boost initiation always drops the node lock before returning and drops the boost mutex only after, when ownership was observed; stall checks nest root inside leaf across the warned-flag update.
Read-write tests take read hold per iteration with delay forms holding across pauses, spin forms hold preemption, and typesafe reads use ref, spin or sequence under outer protection.

state_machines.text: Normal completion clears bits upward, ignores stale sequences or cleared bits with need reasserted, marks nodes quiescent when drained, and wakes the grace thread only at a quiescent root.
Expedited completion clears per-CPU needs then node masks upward, releases tick dependencies, diverts to boost when only blocked tasks remain, and wakes the waiter only at an empty root.
Forward progress pairs version checks with callback flood until launders or timeout and flags shortfalls; barrier episodes reset, publish, queue and recover; pressure forces stop, free and drain.
Read-exit spawns short children that idle then read once with reclamation between bursts; lag testing alternates enabled and disabled dwells until shutdown.
Typesafe reads pick a random slot under protection, observe version, acquire, revalidate, optionally delay, re-read and release, retrying on failure and warning on torn payload.

structs.text: Expedited state holds per-CPU needs, node masks, blocked-task presence, root completion, and a global wait queue with tick release on clearing.
Torture holds forward slots with sync and callback lists, barrier workers with queues, counters and phase, plus read-exit stop flags and wait queue.
Refscale keeps reader records, main thread and array, typesafe records with payloads and guards, pointer array, and named default type and log marker.
